title: Corro bluff deck
description: One locale's questions for a bluff package: each with the true answer that hides among the players' bluffs.

question.description: The question as the table reads it, with a blank (___) where the answer goes.

truth.description: The true answer, as it is revealed. A bluff matching it is refused.

alsoTrue.description: Other spellings or wordings of the truth, refused as bluffs like the truth itself.
